output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Everyone who can have the flag is on build 7.4.0, and that build crashes at about 2% from 2 Sep, before the flag ramp began. Build 7.3.2 stays at about 0.7%. Within 7.4.0, flag-on users crash only 0.12 points more than the random holdout, and that difference could be zero. Device mix and usage are similar across the groups. The sync-service deploy shows no effect on 7.3.2. The leading crash cluster, about 41% of events, is in the upgraded Pixelda image library decoding HEIF images, and it appears only in 7.4.0. The crash-reporting SDK change doesn't explain it, because the app store's own counts match. Don't turn the flag off and release 7.4.0 to everyone: that would ship the real problem to all users and leave the incident unresolved. Hold the rollout at 25%, and fix the Pixelda crashes first, for example by reverting the library or patching the HEIF decoding. Keep the existing holdout, and consider widening it, to settle whether the flag adds a small effect, which can't be ruled out yet. Confidence is fairly high on the build being the main driver and moderate on the flag's own effect.
